subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should `sync` change its established replacement behavior to merge-by-default and require existing users to opt into `--restore` when they want replacement semantics?
rationale: This is a persistent archive and CLI-default contract change, not only a mechanical tombstone fix; current users may observe retained historical rows after upgrading.

options.title: Adopt merge by default with safeguards
options.body: Keep the proposed durable-archive direction after fixing handle remapping, documenting upgrade behavior, and providing inspectable real-run proof.

options.title: Preserve replacement as the default
options.body: Keep current replacement semantics and expose retention/merge only through an explicitly chosen mode if maintainers do not want the default archive contract to change.

recommendation.title: Adopt merge by default with safeguards
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed durable-archive direction after fixing handle remapping, documenting upgrade behavior, and providing inspectable real-run proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository policy provides the only direct signal for an archive-contract product decision.
